requirements.reason: The current repository-owned database value, default, and SQL-safety surface must be cataloged in one deterministic source-owned contract.
Persisted timestamps and deliberate update timestamps must remain timezone-aware without naive Python datetime or implicit ORM onupdate behavior.
Money-bearing fields and provider-facing values must stay exact integer cents with explicit current USD-only handling.
Database-created status defaults and service-persisted status values must remain compatible with current model constraints and schemas.
JSON and JSONB defaults and payload shapes must avoid shared mutable defaults and round-trip safely through PostgreSQL.
Current production raw SQL and migration SQL expressions in this pass's scope must remain fixed, parameterized, or explicitly allowlisted.
Repository-owned application logging must not intentionally expose raw SQL values, provider payloads, credentials, payment details, personal data, or sensitive database values.
Accepted database, transaction, and invariant contracts must remain intact while later-owned infrastructure, migration, payment, and deployed observability evidence stays outside WS04-02C.
